title: Glowing snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2b3a6b'/>
  <!-- bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='21' fill='#eaf4ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#b8d4f0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M36 70 Q50 78 64 70' fill='none' stroke='#c6dcf2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15.5' fill='#f4faff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15.5' fill='none' stroke='#c0d9f2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='12' fill='#f8fcff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#c8def4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- eyes: glowing coal -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='28' r='2.6' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='28' r='2.6' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <path d='M50 32 L64 35 L50 37 Z' fill='#ff8a2b'/>
  <path d='M50 33.5 L61 35 L50 35.6 Z' fill='#ffb366'/>
  <!-- smile: glowing coals -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='1.6' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='1.6' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- buttons on middle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='2' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- stick arms -->
  <path d='M35 50 L18 40 M18 40 L13 43 M18 40 L22 34' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M65 50 L82 40 M82 40 L87 43 M82 40 L78 34' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- hat -->
  <path d='M36 22 L36 14 Q50 6 64 14 L64 22 Z' fill='#2f4a8a'/>
  <rect x='33' y='21' width='34' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#3d5db0'/>
  <rect x='33' y='21' width='34' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a7fd6'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M37 39 Q50 45 63 39 L63 44 Q50 50 37 44 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M37 39 Q50 45 63 39 L63 41 Q50 47 37 41 Z' fill='#ff7a6e'/>
  <path d='M60 43 L66 56 L58 57 L55 45 Z' fill='#c9352e'/>
  <path d='M60 43 L62 48 L56 47 Z' fill='#ff7a6e'/>
</svg>
